_comment: Model roster and context arms. Roster rule: models released within roughly the last two months at freeze time - a benchmark of current tooling should run current models. Tier names are how charts group models; exact model ids are pinned at freeze time. Meta models route through OpenRouter (no native Meta provider in leviath yet). The mockx entry exists only for offline smoke runs against the deterministic script provider.
_released: Release dates are the date the model became generally available on its API; for the GPT-5.6 family that is the 2026-07-09 general launch, not the 2026-06-26 limited-preview announcement. run_quality.py records each model's age at round start in round.json.

Kimi K3.override_reason: runtime resolves this model to a 128000 window; the provider reports 1048576

Muse Spark 1.2.override_reason: runtime resolves this model to a 128000 window; the provider reports 1048576

_context_window: Context window in tokens, pinned per model and written into the runtime's config as a model_capabilities override. Region budgets are percentages of the window, so the window decides how big every region is; the runtime's own table is incomplete (OpenRouter-fronted models resolve to 128000 while their providers report 1048576), which would silently shrink every region on those models. Each value here was verified against the provider, and the resolved window is recorded in every round.
